files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.4%
She presents no obvious external symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.2 u/L
Degree of infection is minor and physical symptoms are not yet present.

Fang shows off a Kuranta's natural dominance in battle by always holding the most advantageous position at the critical moment. To strike a balance between power and control, Fang prefers to use a spear, which she applies with versatility in any situation. Fang acts impulsively and springs into action before others even finish talking.

Immigrants from many nations came to the outskirts of Columbia. Fang, Kroos, and Beagle all met there after moving from their respective homelands. After realizing their common goals, they joined the city guard and underwent basic training together. The humorless Fang, the gentle Beagle, and the laid-back Kroos possess wildly different personalities yet rely on one another for support.

Before an election day, a Catastrophe struck the outskirts of Columbia. In their efforts to aid others in escaping, all three Operators were infected with Oripathy. Fang suffered discrimination due to her condition and fell into deep despair. Kroos rallied the three of them and together they went to Rhodes Island.

After arriving at Rhodes Island, Fang and her two companions as well as Hibiscus and Lava were all trained by Dobermann. The training was extraordinarily intense, and Kroos and Hibiscus seized every opportunity they could to goof off. Even Fang as their captain couldn't do anything to control them. Currently, Fang is training herself to be as intense and strict as her teacher, Dobermann. However, if the giddy expression on her face as she eats fruit is any indication, she's got a long way to go.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Is there anything I can help you with, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Thank you for believing in me! I'll keep up my work!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hibiscus and Lava are fighting again... What a pain. Why are they like this? They're sisters.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Instructor Dobermann puts us through mock battles a lot, but I can never get a handle on her skill. Doctor, next time you and Amiya observe our training, would you please give us some notes?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Someone on my team is late again, huh? I'll make sure that gets fixed.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Lava and I are both Infected, but I didn't get a talent for Arts like she did...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island is our home and shelter, Doctor. I will protect everyone here with my life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The ever-honest and reliable Beagle, the perceptive Kroos, the resourceful Lava and the energetic Hibiscus. I like everyone in this team... as long as Hibiscus doesn't force her health food innovations on me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Shhh! The Doctor's resting. We can talk outside.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Lancer Fang, captain of Reserve Op Team A1. My team and I will do our best to serve Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you for your guidance.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Your approval means so much to me, Doctor. This promotion proves my hard work is paying off.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I know the captain's duty well. Rest easy.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Team, check your gear before departing.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy spotted. Prepare to fight!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready for action.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: On standby.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Leave it to us.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Thrust!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Everyone, follow me!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With the right plan, even rookies like us can win a tough fight!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We have accomplished our objective as planned.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We can't call a mission complete if we let even a single enemy get through. Beagle, let's do better on the next one.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry I failed you, Instructor Dobermann...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Yes. I'm back. Is Kroos here too?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahh...!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Am I helping?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Our team's going to eat dinner together, and we were just about to invite Instructor Dobermann. Would you like to come as well? I have some combat-related questions I'd like to ask, too... Oh, sorry, I know I shouldn't be mentioning work on a holiday.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I'm ready whenever you need me, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! We got you a birthday present as a team. Have you seen Kroos? We agreed to do this together, and she still vanished. Anyway, whatever she told you, just don't believe a word of it, we did actually—awgh! Krooth! Whah ah yoo cavvarin m' mauph phor?!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Looking at our set goals, I've already finished all my training, the other members of my team have made huge progress under Dobermann's instruction too, and we're adapting better and better on the combat side of things. Doctor, I'll be a better captain than I'm now, I promise.
